Initial release of golang-design-patterns skill:

- Provides idiomatic Go design patterns for API design, constructors, error flow, resource management, graceful shutdown, resilience, dependency injection, and data handling.
- Includes best practices on functional options, avoiding init(), error handling, limits, streaming, resource cleanup, and design for testability.
- Offers ready-to-use code snippets for constructors, enums, regex compilation, embed, and interface checks.
- Design mode and review mode guidance for selecting and assessing Go patterns in real-world projects.
- Intended for developers structuring or reviewing Go code for production quality and maintainability.
